description: Scan a web app for security leaks an attacker could find from the outside: Supabase/Firebase data readable by anyone, secret API keys in client code, public storage buckets, exposed .env/.git files, source maps, vulnerable libraries and missing security headers. Read-only: it never changes the app or its data. Pass the local dev server URL (e.g. http://localhost:5173) to scan right away with no setup, or the live URL (e.g. https://myapp.com); the first live scan returns a meta tag to add and deploy to prove ownership. Local scans also read the project folder on disk (unprotected Supabase migrations, secrets in code or .env files, open Firebase rules); your code and findings never leave the machine.

browser.description: Also open the page in the user's installed Chrome (headless) to see which trackers fire before and after rejecting the cookie banner. Slower (up to ~45s); needs Chrome. Off by default.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the project folder to also check, for local scans. Defaults to the server's working directory.

url.description: The app's URL: a local dev server like http://localhost:5173, or the live site like https://myapp.com

name: shippable_scan
title: Shippable security scan
